message.content:
{
  "summary": "Valve FV-101 position does not follow command with an active discrepancy alarm raised at 2026-10-05 10:02 (command is 37.4 %, ZT-101 position is 16.9 %, and the gap is 20.5). The likely root cause is a jammed valve trim due to fibre and lint, a seized stem, a loss of instrument air, a failed positioner, or a position transmitter fault.",
  "likely_causes": [
    "Loss of instrument air to the actuator, or a failed positioner.",
    "Fibre and lint jamming the valve trim, or a seized stem.",
    "Position transmitter fault (the valve moves but ZT-101 does not)."
  ],
  "checks": [
    "Check the instrument air pressure at the actuator and the positioner output.",
    "Look at the valve stem and position indicator locally and compare them with ZT-101 on the HMI.",
    "Check whether the forward flow FIT-102 changes when the command changes.",
    "Compare the influent flow FIT-101 with the forward flow FIT-102.",
    "Check the level locally on the tank gauge."
  ],
  "handover": "At 2026-10-05 10:17, valve FV-101 in the equalisation area has an active discrepancy alarm with ZT-101 at 16.9 % against a command of 37.4 %. The operator needs to complete immediate checks for stuck valves as per SOP-07 and SOP-11.",
  "citations": [
    "SOP-07 7.3",
    "SOP-07 7.4",
    "SOP-07 7.2",
    "SOP-11 11.3",
    "SOP-11 11.4"
  ]
}
